articles.title: Google Awarded a $250,000 Bounty for a Full-chain Chrome Exploit Found Using GPT-5.6
articles.summary:
XBOW says its security researchers earned a $250,000 reward from Google after building a full-chain Chrome exploit with AI agents. The team says the work took six days and about $40,000 in computing costs, using OpenAI’s publicly available GPT-5.6 Sol model. Google has fixed the flaws. XBOW disclosed the work on October 13, 2026. Its […]

articles.title: Windows SmartScreen Vulnerability Enables Privilege Escalation Attacks
articles.summary:
Microsoft has released fixes for a Windows SmartScreen vulnerability that allows an attacker with local access to gain higher privileges. Tracked as CVE-2026-85851, the flaw was disclosed on October 13, 2026, and carries a CVSS base score of 7.8. Microsoft rates it Important. articles.title: Hackers Breach Meta GitHub Repositories, Steal Source Code and Data of 1,500 People
articles.summary:
Hackers used an employee’s stolen credentials to access some of Meta’s GitHub repositories, taking product source code and personal information linked to roughly 1,500 people. Most affected individuals are Meta employees in the United States, according to the company’s disclosure to SecurityWeek. Meta confirmed the breach on October 13, 2026, when it began notifying affected […]

articles.title: Attackers Breach European Bank Through Third-Party Gateway and Target WSUS Server
articles.summary:
A European bank was breached through a poorly secured, third-party gateway before an attacker tried to exploit its Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) infrastructure. The case shows how stolen login details and weak access controls can put a bank’s central software systems at risk without a complex attack chain. The bank’s security team uncovered unauthorized […]

articles.title: Gears of War: E-Day Hit by DDoS Attack, Causing Login Failures and Disconnects
articles.summary:

The official Gears Community account confirmed the cause on X, linking the disruption to DDoS activity and ending speculation about the source of the failures. articles.title: Ivanti Connect Secure 0-Days Exploited to Steal Active Directory Credentials
articles.summary:
Attackers chained three zero-day flaws in Ivanti Connect Secure VPN appliances to gain root-level access without logging in, then searched for credentials and sensitive Active Directory data. The activity, which began on October 3, 2026, targeted a fully patched appliance running version 22.8R2.4, showing that keeping a device current did not protect it from these […]

articles.title: Windows BitLocker Vulnerabilities Security Feature Bypass and Privilege Elevation Attacks
articles.summary:
Microsoft fixed three Windows BitLocker vulnerabilities CVE-2026-85920, CVE-2026-88070, and CVE-2026-83500 that could enable privilege escalation or bypass security protections in its October 2026 updates. articles.title: Hackers Abuse Google Search to Attacks ITadmins with Weaponized PuTTY Installer
articles.summary:
IT administrators searching Google for PuTTY may see a convincing fake download result mixed with legitimate links. Researchers documented a campaign that uses a lookalike website to deliver a malicious Windows installer disguised as the popular SSH client. The installer opens a working PuTTY window as a decoy while secretly starting a separate malware chain […]
